paper1_reading.structure: Part A (Compulsory), Part B1 (Easier) or Part B2 (Difficult)

language.7: Extremely accurate grammar, vocabulary well-chosen, punctuation entirely correct.
language.4: Mostly accurate grammar with occasional errors, sufficient sentence structures.

Pronunciation & Delivery.7: Native-like intonation, clear articulation, effective stress.
Pronunciation & Delivery.4: Generally clear, some errors in stress/intonation but understood.

Communication Strategies.7: Sustains interaction effectively, excellent turn-taking skills.
Communication Strategies.4: Maintains interaction, responds appropriately most times.

paper3_listening.structure: Part A (Short Tasks), Part B (Integrated Tasks - B1/B2)

scoring_part_b.content: Cumulative points based on evidence library (Max 18)

language.9: Sophisticated range of sentence structures, extremely high accuracy, wide range of vocabulary.
language.5: Satisfactory accuracy, standard sentence structures, adequate vocabulary for the task.
language.1: Fragmented, simple vocabulary only, many errors.

organization.9: Perfectly coherent, sophisticated use of cohesive ties, layout entirely appropriate.
organization.5: Generally coherent, some use of linking words, layout is clear.

appropriacy.6: Excellent audience awareness, tone and register entirely appropriate throughout.
appropriacy.3: Tone is generally appropriate but inconsistent in parts.
appropriacy.1: Inappropriate tone for the genre or audience.
